snippet.title: Cinematic Game Teaser| Upcoming Game
snippet.description:
It took us 4 days to create this cinematic video for our next upcoming game.
Yes! We are still working on it. 
This video is just a teaser for the genre ;)


Stay tuned for more!


Some music from Elemental Demo.
